task.title: Briefing Intelligence: section contracts and weight-pace authority - real Sep 20-26 preview for Founder review (candidate a1ea5aab, not deployed)

result.summary: Shared section contracts (headline/recap/meaning/confidence/takeaway/coaching/action/watch, each consuming a distinct facet of the holistic synthesis; per-type budgets Midweek<Weekly<Monthly, DEXA outcome-led, Photo visual-led and scaled) with structural and text anti-redundancy audits. Weekly: short headline ('Strong training week, but a quiet finish.'), evidence-rich hero paragraph, interpreting Biggest Takeaway distinct from the Hero, execution in What To Do. Weight-rate audit: the lean-mass lb/wk thresholds were an engine heuristic contradicting the accepted Phase Expected Trajectory (universalWeeklyRate null); goal types now own direction only and pace is judged only against a canonical signed range (consumer ready, not wired) or the person's own trend - Sep 20-26 weight (1.68 lb/wk, not accelerating) is now described, not called 'climbing fast'. Confidence 79 hold and recommendation unchanged.

tests.summary: 123 Briefing Intelligence tests (section-contract properties over 5 goal types x 18 situations x 8 seeds, holistic properties, hand-built pictures, failing-audit and mutation-guarding tests); full repo 9039/9347 vs production baseline 8913/9221, 0 new failures.

review.summary: Five fresh-context rounds (1defc3c7, 39c5e2e5, 4b3fb6bb, 90de1a13, e557e94e), all PASS-WITH-FIXES; every finding fixed, final fixes in a1ea5aab with tests (no further round after that last wording fix).

Whether to regenerate the published Sep 20-26 Weekly (not done; separate authorization).
